experiment.sizeDefinition: UTF-8 attribute-name plus string-value bytes, excluding storage overhead; all attributes are strings.
experiment.timing: Sequence numbers sort invocation timestamps, not completion. Pressure waves use concurrency 8; supplemental mixed waves use concurrency 12. No SDK retries. Control polls sleep two seconds.

mixedPressure.verification: Unique attributes are checked by wave-end strongly consistent projections.

experiment.supplementalExecution: mixed_pressure from the runnable probe was invoked against the already-owned base table while the original capture exercised the GSI table; no extra table was created. Calls merged by invocation timestamp and all references remapped. The runnable probe now includes mixed_pressure before proceeding to the GSI table; timing/order can affect outcomes.

limitations: A bounded regional capture does not identify deterministic throttle ordinals or exact refill/burst algorithms.

AWS documents up to 300 seconds of unused capacity, best-effort burst/background consumption, and adaptive partition capacity: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/burst-adaptive-capacity.html
Projected reads still consume capacity for the full underlying item. Verification uses strongly consistent base-table reads and retains actual capacity.
Native asynchronous GSI pressure is attributed only by returned resource/reason fields, never merely by request timing.

Both tables were seeded on-demand then switched to provisioned throughput. Cold fresh-PROVISIONED 1 WCU admission remains unmeasured. ACTIVE is settled control state, not proof of internal admission convergence.
No BatchWriteItem unprocessed siblings were reached: both bounded attempts returned empty UnprocessedItems and all mutations were verified. This is not a guarantee of all-or-nothing batches.
Sparse writes succeeded after index-attributed rejections, but subsequent projected writes also recovered; sparse exemption under continuously active GSI pressure remains unresolved.

False-condition behavior was observed between pressure waves, not simultaneously with a proven provisioned-table admission rejection. Cancellation-reason transaction throttling was not reached; top-level transaction throughput errors were reached.
